# A context provider inside a component the optimizer specializes at its call
# site survives until the lowering, so the optimizer's statement walks meet it.
#
# `rows` is called with a constant list, which makes it a candidate for
# call-site specialization, and findParamSyms walks its body through
# walkStmtExprs before passContext has run. Without the provider arm there,
# every target panics with "walkStmtExprs: unhandled stmt *ir.ContextProvider".

sngl generate --platform bubbletea --lang go --out out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

context #theme("light")

component rows(items list<string>) ui.node {
    theme("dark") {
        ui.vbox {
            for var x = items {
                ui.text(value=x)
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window #home(title="t") {
    rows(items=["a", "b"])
}
